dedupe_keys.name: pigoo programa de indicadores de gestion de organismos operadores mexican water utility performance indicators 2002 2025

description: PIGOO is the performance indicator programme for Mexican water and sanitation operators (organismos operadores de agua potable, alcantarillado y saneamiento), produced by the Instituto Mexicano de Tecnología del Agua (IMTA) from data that the participating operators submit each year. The web system gives fact sheets for 68 variables and 32 indicators (continuous service, metering, treated volume, complaints, costs, staffing, supply per capita, physical, commercial and collection efficiencies, pipe rehabilitation, rationing hours, tanker supply, water and sewer coverage, losses per connection and per km of network, energy use and cost), a map of participating operators by year and a reports page. Coverage is the participating operators across Mexico: the reports page lists 556 operators and the years 2002 to 2025. The variables, indicators and participation tables are a free download as Excel (XLSX) for any period and operator; no licence is stated. Caveats: participation is voluntary and varies by year, values are reported by the operators, who are responsible for their accuracy, and indicators still under validation are marked "en revisión". Simulation uses: operator-level losses, network rehabilitation, service continuity and energy use for capacity planning and resilience baselines of urban water utilities. Related records: the Indian Performance Assessment System (data-india-pas-urban-water-sanitation-service-level-benchmarks).
